items.author: boobachu.bsky.social
items.context: Farming games are so stressful, why?
items.text: They really can feel like a second job with all the timers. Games like Dorfromantik or Unpacking have no clock at all, which can be a nice change.

items.author: cjediknight87.bsky.social
items.context: Why does The Wind Can Be Still from Stardew Valley instantly hit me in the feels? Every single time. Such a fucking beautiful track, but I seriously don't know why it makes me cry. Lol.
items.text: That one has a way of getting to people. Quiet music like that can hold a lot of memories without saying a word.

items.author: lewcidgm.bsky.social
items.context: It’s always the dilemma, yeah? A. Attack the backlog B. Default back to your “comfort” games C. Do something else that’s not a video game (the horror!!!)
items.text: Comfort games are a perfectly good answer, there's no rule that the backlog has to go first. Sometimes a familiar game is exactly the way to wind down.
